advance_prep.instruction: Soak chickpeas for falafel. Do not cook them first

steps.text: Use soaked, uncooked chickpeas. Drain well and pulse with onion, herbs, garlic and spices into a coarse crumb, not a paste.
steps.cue: The mixture looks like coarse crumbs and just holds together when you squeeze a handful.
steps.tip: Pulse in short bursts. A smooth paste bakes dense.

steps.text: Stir in besan, baking powder and salt and rest 15 minutes.
steps.cue: The mixture feels drier and holds together when pressed into a ball.

steps.text: Shape into small patties. Weights in recipes are for the raw mixture.
steps.cue: A patty keeps its shape when lifted, with no cracks around the edge.
steps.tip: Wet your hands so the mixture does not stick.

steps.text: Bake on an oiled tray at 200°C for 25 minutes, turning once.
steps.cue: Patties are deep golden and firm, and feel crisp when tapped.
steps.tip: Space them out on the tray so they crisp instead of steaming.
